mentions.name: Canadian Employment Contract Analyzer
mentions.description: A tool that analyzes employment contracts to flag potential issues and lets users ask labor law questions covering Canada.
mentions.problem: Employment contracts may contain issues that are difficult to identify, and labor law questions can be hard to get answered.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a new tool that can analyze employment contracts and see if there are issues.  Also gives the ability to ask labor questions across Canada

evidence.value: Building a new tool that can analyze employment contracts and see if there are issues.  Also gives the ability to ask labor questions across Canada
